programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Through the years, we’ve had some amazing vehicles featured on GearZ—from elite racecars to the insanity of a V-8 barstool. Well, here we go again! Stacey hauls in a Thiokol Imp that needs some…attention. First things first with this crazy snowcatmobile; we’ve got to see if we can make it run. Follow along as Stacey takes you through the ins and outs of getting a neglected vehicle up and running again. For you performance BMW guys, a tuner from Dinan is going add the horses you’ve been looking for. We’ve got sparks flying, fuel splashing and all kinds of garage mayhem this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: In the world of car building there are few things more ominous than missing titles or VIN numbers. But there is one task that stands out, one that brings grown men to tears, one that is usually lurking behind 100 yards of electrical tape…WIRING. Well hold on tight as Stacey dives head first into wiring Sergeant Rock. That’s right; see how painless Stacey can make wiring the big old truck. Follow along as Stacey moves front to back and gets the Rock one step closer to hitting the road!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With summer in full swing, it’s time to cool down that classic truck of yours. That’s right, roll those windows up and feel the cool breeze as Stacey shows just how easy it is to install this complete AC system from LMC Truck. Now that you’re done sweatin’, let’s take a look at headers and intakes and get that motor performing the way it should. And don’t miss out on the ins and outs of turbos and super-chargers…which one fits your needs? All this and plenty of sparks in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey and the GearZ crew heat things up as they head to the Cornwell forges to watch molten steel be expertly transformed into America’s best ratchet. Get ready to see sparks fly. But the trip doesn’t stop there. Tag along as the crew follows what it takes for a ratchet to end up on a Cornwell truck. Back in the garage, Stacey talks maximizing boost and the role of intercoolers when it comes to super-chargers and turbos. The wheels keep turning and the rubber keeps burning, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Cheetah lovers will be excited to see Stacey’s solution to keeping the headers both cool and looking red hot. Want to keep using your stock tank after converting to fuel injection? Get psyched, because Holley has a new fuel pump that’s going to make your life a whole lot easier. Think your car is buttoned up tight? Stacey and some friends from Redline Detection blow smoke at the old soap and water test and show you how to really test for leaks in your vehicle. It’s a world of problems out there, but Stacey’s got you covered in the garage. All this and more, this week, on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: This week Stacey and crew head to Memphis, TN to help out a local BBQ pitmaster who’s deep into a ground up rebuild of a ’72 Nova. The big challenge here?...Can you swap out an automatic transmission with a manual without losing your mind? Well, Stacey is always up for a good challenge and he’ll show you just how simple this swap can be. A new tuner from Super chips will make your Jeep life easier, and replacement dashes for Chevy owners are going to light up their eyes. There’s a lot going on in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Cheap Fuel Injection Snow Cat Bed TN Electric Guitar
programme.desc: We’re winding up the tenth season of GearZ, and what a season it’s been! But we’ve got some business to take care of before we move onto season eleven. First things first…Holley just made an EFI even easier to install on your carbureted vehicle, and Stacey will show you just how on target the Sniper is. The Thiokol Imp gets a suspension upgrade to keep it on track. And there’s a new kind of off-roading that’s sweeping the nation…see what RC4WD has going on. And what season would be complete without guitars? Check out Tennessee Electric Company as Stacey introduces a new guitar-maker whose custom guitars are hotter than the asphalt at the drag strip.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re back and taking it to the streets! Season 11 comes roaring back with a look at Super Lite Cars on the road and the track! Stacey recalls and earlier SLC build and introduces two SLC builders who took a very hands-on approach to putting their cars together. These street/race cars are sure to catch your eye and get your racing blood flowing. If there’s one thing Stacey preaches on every episode, it’s paying attention to the details. His quick tip is no exception, getting rid of those sharp edges and nasty welds to give your project the small details that people will notice. Side mirrors for a muscle car, building a better battery, and keeping your air flowing through carbon fiber vents fill out the parts bin. We’ve got all this and more as Stacey kicks of his 11th season of GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: This is the moment you’ve been waiting for! Master car builder, Stacey David, shows off the truck that’s had the nation talking for ten years! Take a look back at the kid with the dream. Follow the design and fabrication. See what happens when the military tribute vehicle rolls out and conquers the road! This episode is gonna be epic. It’s been a long road, but anything worth doing well is worth the wait. This week, the wait is over. Sergeant Rock Lives!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: On the Road & Unicure Spray Booths
programme.desc: Things are rockin’ and rollin’ in and out of the GearZ garage. Stacey hits the road to find a project build that will get gear heads buzzing. He ends up with an ’81 Camaro and some awesome stories from the seller. If you’re talking project vehicles, you’ve got to talk paint! And Stacey does just that with folks from Unicure, who specialize in paint booths and helping you get set up for that all important paint job. The V-8 Interceptor is back from a trip to Stainless works, where a custom exhaust system was made for the big Boss Nine engine. Things are about to get loud, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: The Return of Heavy Metal & Snowcat
programme.desc: Stacey and the GearZ crew roll in an old favorite: Heavy Metal. The coolest hotrod tow truck is back in the garage and ready for a facelift. Our good friends at the Hot Rod Institute drop by and talk shop with Stacey about his plans for the paint and fab work needed to get this bad boy looking good and back on the road. Fresh from the sandblaster, the snowcat reveals the scars that were under the skin. And with the drive train out, Stacey walks through the importance of replacing gaskets, seals and checking for wear and tear before stuffing that engine, transmission and skid steer rear end back into the cat. There’s a whole lot going on this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Every gear head has a secret: they all want to drive like McQueen in Bullitt, or Vin Diesel in The Fast And The Furious. But when the heat gets turned up, even some really good drivers can’t keep up. That’s when you bring in the Stunt Double! This week Stacey sits down with legendary Hollywood stunt man Ian Quinn to talk crashing cars and keeping actors out of harms way. There’s also a new project in the garage: The Stunt Double, a build inspired by the 80’s tv show The Fall Guy, and sure to get all four wheels off the ground before Stacey’s done with it. Sparks are going to fly and you know we’re gonna have a good time this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Seems like you can’t go more than a block these days without running into someone whose had some work done on their face. Well, here at the GearZ garage, Stacey believes in facelifts too. Just to prove it, he’s taken on a 1981 Camaro and sharpened his scalpel to perform an automotive nose job. Just wait till you see him whack of the old rubber nose and replace it with a 71’ rally sport front end! Now that’s what we call a facelift. Plenty of people said it couldn’t be done, but that’s just the kind of challenge Stacey is up for. Plenty of sparks are gonna fly, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: They say that true change comes from within… Well, this week Stacey turns his attention to the interior of the Stunt Double. The old, crusty junk hits the floor and our Fall Guy inspired build gets a new look: from painting trim and door panels, to a new bench seat. Man o’ man, this truck is starting to look completely different. A shower of sparks lights up the garage as Stacey demonstrates how to make a bracket that mounts our new bench seat to the truck while using the stock seat adjustment. It’s a tour de force of aftermarket parts and salvaging what we’ve got, this week on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: When you’re putting together a project that’s inspired by a high-flying stunt truck, you know you’ve got to add some lift, and our Stunt Double gets the goods this week. The front and rear suspension get treated to a 6” lift to get that rig up in the air. But a good lift won’t do any good if the steering and frame can’t hold up, so Stacey shows you how Offroad Design has fixed some serious issues that many late model four-wheel drives encounter. Bed need to come off your truck, but the carriage bolts are rusted and spinning? Stacey’s got a fix for that too. There’s a lot going on, and we’ve got you covered, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Everyone needs a little boost here and there. For some people, coffee does the trick. But here in the GearZ Garage we take our boost seriously. And we like ours packing 160 HP. Hang on to your seat as Stacey adds a bolt on Supercharger to a Ram 1500 breathes a little excitement into a daily driver. And speaking of things going on in the garage, you’ll definitely want to stick around as Stacey talks shop with the guys at Rebuilding Generations. Learn all about how this mentoring program is teaching the next generation about working on cars and sharing plenty of life lessons. We’ve got a lot going on this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re running full steam ahead as the Stunt Double rolls back into the shop this week! First, Stacey reveals the wheels and tires that are going to accentuate that 6” lift, then He dives headlong into the drivetrain of this beast and comes up with a hot crate engine and a high-performance transmission to get the Stunt Double ready for the road. But that’s not all…. We also take some time out for a visit with the guys from American Powertrain and so much more. Check out the sparks flying in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s business as usual in the garage this week. We’re back at work on the Catalog Camaro and really diggin’ into the front end. You know what they say, “out with the old and in with the new,” and that’s exactly what Stacey’s doing. The old sub frame, drivetrain, and suspension are hitting the garage floor in favor of a much-needed updated suspension system that’ll keep this awesome Camaro hugging the road at high speeds—From the wheels to the sub frame, Stacey’s replacing it all. And he’s not going to break the bank while doing it, either. Follow the GearZ crew as they hit the road and visit Cornwell Tools to see their latest and greatest tool box being manufactured. From powder coat to knuckle bustin’ bolts, we’ve got you covered this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We head out of the garage to visit one of the premiere supercharger manufacturers in the world… ATI Pro Charger. Follow along for the ride as Stacey walks through the entire process of how they have raised the bar on how a supercharger is built and what it does. From bulk metal to dyno runs, we’ve got it covered. Back in the garage, a young Gearhead drops by to learn how to install an air intake and cowl induction hood on his pick-up. After the wrench turning is done, he and Stacey have enough time to hit a few licks on their guitars. From massive horsepower increases with state-of-the-art tools and machinery, to simple intake and hood installs,….. it’s all here, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

The city is creating a new generation of green skyscrapers that harvest rainwater and run on solar power.

programme.desc: Manhattan may be one of the world’s liveliest and richest places, but it is a slender island just 21 kilometers long and very crowded. Its buildings have been getting taller and taller. Many buildings from previous centuries need to be upgraded or replaced. The infrastructure is also severely strained. So large-scale eco-friendly redevelopment is on the cards, and the creation of neighborhoods that are pleasant places to live and work.

programme.title: DW Cities Reinvented
programme.sub-title: Cities Reinvented E02 - Tokyo - The Urban Village Concept
programme.desc: The Greater Tokyo Area is the world’s most populous metropolitan region, and it is continuing to grow at a fast pace. Urban-planning solutions are urgently needed to prevent Tokyo from choking on its own growth. Strategies include raising density, promoting shared housing and micro-homes, and investing in ‘urban villages’, neighborhoods where people can live, work and spend their leisure time.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programme.desc: Known for its arid steppes, skilled nomadic horsemen and Genghis Khan, a visit to Mongolia feels like a trip back in time. At the annual Naadam Festival, contestants vie to be the victor in the centuries-old pursuits of wrestling, archery and horseracing. In episode twelve, Art Wolfe pursues prehistoric wild horses as they roam the steppe; rides in the mountains with a Kazakh tribesman who hunts with golden eagles; and catches up with nomadic reindeer herders at their summer camp near the Siberian border.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: According to mythology, Anagni was established by Saturn himself in an area surrounded by huge calcareous walls. Historically, we know that the town was conquered by the Roman Empire at the beginning of the IV century B.C. Even though it was influenced by the Holy See, during the Middle Age Anagni was a free town where two families, the Caetanis and the Colonnas, fought hard for supremacy.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: National Treasures
programme.desc: Griff Rhys Jones visits one of the grandest Restoration houses in Britain to find out why they have taken on what was once known as 'the most expensive council house in Britain'. Just off the M4 motorway in south Wales lies the jewel in the crown of Newport - Tredegar House - home to generations of the glittering Morgan dynasty and now a feather in the cap of National Trust Wales.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: Today's adventure begins in Machu Picchu, to learn about the fascinating culture of the Incas. You will cross amazing roads, you will meet the ruins and you will be able to see a place as amazing as The Citadel. We will see the street of Hatun Rumiyuq, where once was the palace of Inca Roca and all the incredible work in stone for which Cuzco is known. Our second destination will take you to Saint Petersburg, the historic Russian capital. We will visit the Hermitage Museum to see part of its immense collection, the largest in the world with almost three million works of art! In addition, you can enjoy the most delicious dishes of Russian food: the "Kotlety" which are small, fried meatballs made of ground meat. Cancun is the final destination of this episode. We'll immerse ourselves in both: its waters and its history, visiting some of its emblematic beaches and go to Tulum, a very interesting archaeological site.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In our first episode, you find us at a boatyard in the small fishing town of Chioggia - at the southern end of the Venice Lagoon, preparing the yacht for its voyage. We will show you around this lovely town, and introduce you to some of the colourful people we’ve come to know here over the years. Chioggia is the busiest fishing port on all of mainland Italy; we will take you to its fish markets, and meet a restaurateur in the kitchen of one of Chioggia’s finest restaurants to see the chefs cook some local specialties. We also go fishing with a father and son, who practice an ancient tradition of net and pole fishing on the Venetian Lagoon. They are called moecanti.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this second episode, we sail into Venice and visit our friend Renato, who has been the head chef at the Cipriani Hotel for over 25 years and has travelled the world as a food ambassador. Renato invites us into his kitchen to make some of his best-loved Venetian dishes. We then visit the famous Rialto markets and cook a few of my favourites in the yacht’s galley. We conclude our Venice adventure by visiting some friends at an old gondola repair yard called a squero. It has been converted into a private retreat featuring an impressive kitchen, from which we experience a memorable Venetian cook-up.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we sail all the way to southern Turkey to visit the picturesque village of Kaleköy in the Kekova area. We introduce you to a local family who run the Likya restaurant, and serve simple delicious Turkish food. We’ve known them for over 30 years, ever since we began sailing here. We also discover how the locals love the carob bean, and how they make a tasty, healthy syrup from it. Finally, we’ll introduce you to our friend Kadriye who cooks up a typical Turkish lunch, and one of her neighbours demonstrates how to make the local pancake called gözleme.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: As our long voyage from Venice continues, we sail from Kastellorizo to Lindos on the island of Rhodes. This is where Patrick and I married, over 30 years ago. In Lindos, we take you to the Melenos kitchen; where the chef, Gogo, will show us her very modern & healthy take on traditional Greek cuisine. We visit Rhodes, where I used to teach ballet, and show you how to prepare artichokes with vinaigrette sauce, the dish that Patrick prepared for me on our very first date! Finally, we visit my godfather, Vangelis, who shows us how to prepare some authentic everyday Greek food.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.sub-title: Food Sail Love: Symi, Santorini, Corinth
programme.desc: In this episode, we will take you to the beautiful Greek island of Symi, where the amphitheatrical harbour displays its distinctive neo classical architecture, very specific to this particular corner of the Aegean. Here we’ll recapture old memories, and cook the local delicacy - Symi shrimps. Our next stop is the extraordinary island of Santorini, where we will celebrate their famous tomatoes, grown in the rich volcanic soil. Finally, we head northwest to the mouth of the Corinth canal - the location of one of our all-time favourite seafood restaurants in the Mediterranean. It’s called Kavos and is run by Pagona and her son, Tassos.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.sub-title: Food Sail Love: Amalfi & Sestri Levante
programme.desc: In this episode, we will sail through the Corinth canal in Greece, cross to the boot of Italy and sail all the way up the west coast to Liguria, to one of our favourite towns – Sestri Levante. On the way, we will stop at Galaxidi, halfway up the Gulf of Corinth, for breakfast after which I will prepare a Moussaka in the galley – under sail. We will then take you to Amalfi and the bay of Naples to pay homage to their lemons and to the Caprese salad, before arriving in the village of Sestri Levante to experience some delicious Ligurian dishes.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In Portofino, we’ll be shown how to make the authentic version of pesto alla Genovese, by chef Corrado at the legendary Hotel Splendido. We will then visit the Canale bakery to see how they make the famous local bread called focaccia; and after that, we will meet up with my dear friend Nina on the yacht in Portofino’s iconic harbour, which is where we met over 25 years ago. She wants to show us how to make a couple of delicious dishes, in the galley.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this, the final episode, we sail along the French Riviera and catch up with some of the people and places we know and love. This region is particularly dear to Patrick; he was born in Marseille and spent all of his childhood summers on this coast. First, we’ll visit St Tropez, including the iconic Club 55; then we’ll take you to Antibes and to a couple of nearby villages, St Paul de Vence and Biot. Each has a restaurant which we count among our favourites, and they have two things in common – traditional Provençal food… and art, which in each case is largely its raison d’être.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Salvatore sigue en peligro de muerte pero no acepta la ayuda que le quiere brindar la UDH. Esta vez, est m s complicado el acertijo que les brind la viuda negra y solo un comentario de Abril hacia Alejandro puede encaminarlos a la resoluci n del mismo. Sof a Carlota escucha a Julio decir que Jos Guillermo es hijo de la Pelusa con Vespasiano, y se lo conf a a Emanuel, ya que no sabe qu hacer. l le recomienda hablar con Ruth antes de contarle todo a Josu , para asegurarse que sea cierto. Sof a habla con Ruth y luego de inventarle una historia, termina reconoci ndole que es verdad, pero que ha sido un error. Josu llega a la casa, y Sof a inventa una historia para que su hermano no se entere la verdad.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 49: Josefina finge desmayo, Charo asustada
programme.desc: Socorro est a punto de abrir la puerta y de descubrir qui n es el amante de su madre. Josefina desesperada y muy nerviosa finge desmayarse. Al otro lado de la puerta, Salvador escucha los gritos de Socorro y escapa del lugar r pidamente.Mariela trata de inventarle a Julio C sar explicaciones, pero finalmente le dice la verdad: todo hacia parte de un plan de Charo para desprestigiarlo.Una enfermera del hospital psiqui trico le pide a Charo explicaciones, pues Sara est a punto de morirse. Charo se marcha asustada. - Socorro, preocupada con por su madre, intenta llamar a una ambulancia pero descubre que Josefina est fingiendo.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 49: Captura de Candelaria y el hijo de Abril
programme.desc: Pantoja realiza una redada policial en donde logra dar con la captura de Candelaria quien es atrapada in fraganti al efectuar la venta de un infante. En la cl nica, Arelys conversa con Gabriel al intentar convencerlo de desistir de su decisi n de abandonar la instituci n de la cual es socio por causa de la estafa en la cual implicaron a su difunto padre. Abril se tortura con el recuerdo de su hijo al sentirse frustrada en su intenci n de lograr informarse por medio de Candelaria del paradero de su hijo, Mirna intenta brindarle consuelo a Abril al recordarle a su amiga las gestiones anticipadas por Herm goras para dar con la localizaci n de su hijo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 92: Celos, Sospechas y Nuevos Romances Secretos.
programme.desc: R mulo aprovecha que llego Eglee y la enfrenta, le pregunta que paso en ese cuarto, ella se queda muda, pues no sabe exactamente a que se debe la pregunta, le explica que ella para cambiar su cuarto no tiene que pedirle opini n a nadie, el luego de criticar la decoraci n le dice que el se refiere es a que estaba haciendo Santiago hasta altas horas de la madrugada en la casa, que ya el sab a que ninguno de los dos hab a ido a la fiesta de Pascuita, ya Eglee entiende que R mulo sabe o sospecha algo, le pregunta que por que la sigue y de paso le recuerda que ya el tiene otra familia y que se encargue de su nueva mujer, que por cierto no debe saber que el la esta celando con otro hombre. R mulo queda desconcertado pues Eglee ni lo neg ni lo afirmo, o se que, quedo pero que cuando no le hab a preguntado nada. Mientras tanto Betzaida esta furiosa pues su marido no aparece por ninguna parte, le cuenta a su mam que R mulo se hab a parado enfrente de la casa de su ex y Nely para tratar de calmar la rabia de su hija trata de justificar a R mulo, cosa que a Betzaida le molesta mucho. Theo por su parte esta feliz, les da la noticia que le consigui un toque al grupo musical, todos se quedan locos pues ellos nunca pensaron que Theo se fuera a tomar las cosas tan en serio, al principio todos dijeron que no pero como Jos Tadeo entiende que el lo que quiere es levantarse a su millonaria entonces deciden ayudarlo y tocar n la semana pr xima. En la oficina se quedan trabajando hasta tarde, Santiago los quiere dejar solos a Luis Fernando y a Dileidi, busca un motivo para irse, pero Luis Fernando le ofrece la cola a Dileidi, pero cuando est n a punto de salir se aparece Aureliano y le ofrece a Dileidi llevarla hasta su casa, Luis Fernando se pone bravo, en ese momento tambi n se aparece la miss, y entonces Luis Fernando se saca la piedrita y coquetea con ella delante de Dileidi, quien aprovecha para decirle a la miss que ahora ella trabaja con su profe papi en la misma oficina, la miss se controla y no le queda mas remedio que felicitarla. Rosa habla con su hija le saca con mucha sutileza e inteligencia lo que paso la noche anterior con Santiago, a Eglee no le queda otra que contarle a su mam que si que paso una noche maravillosa con el muchacho, a lo que su madre le da el visto bueno, le aconseja que lo disfrute que ella conoce varias amigas suyas que tambi n tiene relaciones con hombres mucho mas j venes que ellas, pero Eglee le aclara que en su caso es mas dif cil pues se trata del mejor amigo de su hijo, tambi n le cuenta que ya R mulo sospecha algo pues le estuvo preguntando cualquier cantidad de cosas, Rosa disfruta del chisme como nunca. Gladis lleva a Yuraima a estudiar ya que parece que el Gerson no ir mas bueno no le queda de otra que entonces intentarlo con su nuera, quien asiste muy entusiasmada a su primer d a de clase. Aristigueta no puede creer que su amigo Marco Aurelio este enamorado, sobre todo el que no cree en las relaciones de pareja, pero Marco Aurelio se defiende diciendo que con la mujer que esta saliendo le pasa algo extra o, esa mujer le inspira muchas cosas a la vez, que el la ayuda no por que ella lo necesite pues ya le ha demostrado que para ella o hay obst culo cuando de su familia se trata, total es una mujer fuera de serie en la que Aristigueta nunca se fijar a. Tatiana se re ne con su pap , quiere escuchar ahora la versi n de el, pues solo sabe lo que le ha dicho la Nena de su pap , el por supuesto que le dice cualquier cantidad de mentiras, que ellas son lo mas importante en su vida, que esta arrepentido, que la nica mujer que vale la pena es su mam en fin la muchacha le cree todo el cuento inclusive que esta enfermo y hasta que le dio un infarto. Gonzalo le da la buena noticia a su mujer que le consigui un trabajo para el proyecto del centro comercial que est n construyendo, ella por supuesto que no lo puede creer, le pregunta a Ram n si es verdad que su marido la sugiri a ella y a Ram n no le quedo otra que decir que si que fue idea de Gonzalo. Theo llega a la casa de la Nena para contarle que ya consigui el primer contrato, ella cree que quien lo ayudo fue su amigo el doctor y Theo le dice que no, que fue el solo, pero se lleva una sorpresa al ver en la mesa hay toda clase de exquisiteces, la Nena le dice que sus alumnas decidieron darle un aguinaldo y que ella se lo gasto en esas cosas. Dileidi habla claro con Aureliano, le dice que no ella no esta siendo justa con el, que lo esta utilizando para darle celos a Luis Fernando, Aureliano sabe que es as tal cual como ella se lo dice, ella le confiesa que no puede hacer nada que esta enamorada de Luis Fernando. En la casa de Eglee todos comen hallaca, bueno no todos, Mar a Gracia no come en la tardes por aquello de la figura, otra que no come es Felicita quien se ve gorda o sea que tiene a la bulimia bien cerca de ella. R mulo al fin se digna a llegar a la casa de su nueva suegra, su mujer lo recibe con tremendo l o, los padres de ella de nuevo le dan la raz n a el y Betzaida les aclara que ya esta bueno de que siempre lo justifiquen a el y no a ella. Al d a siguiente en la bodega de Gabito Theo le cuenta a su amigo que le pareci extra o ver tanta comida cara en la casa de su millonaria adem s ella le dio un trato anormal, sinti que no fue sincera, Gabito le explica que eso es normal pues ella alguna vez tuvo mucho dinero y esta acostumbrada a comer bien, pero en eso llega el Gerson y les echa el cuento de que esta trabajando en el edificio donde vive la Nena, Theo le pregunta que si la vio y el le cuenta que hasta le tuvo que llevar el mercado al apartamento, mercado que le regalaba un tal jefe con una camioneta ltimo modelo, Theo se angustia descubre que no es solo el quien esta detr s de Mar a Antonia, tiene competencia y para colmo de males millonario de verdad.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 37: La amenaza de Robert y la furia de Michelle
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo lleva a In s al Instituto donde supuestamente ella da clases y le pide que lo deje entrar pero ella se niega y l le insiste que le diga si l ha sido el nico hombre al que ha amado y ella le dice que si y luego se marcha. Armando le insiste a Robert para que deje su idea de relacionarse seriamente con In s y lo amenaza con el negocio, pero Robert le hace ver que conoce muchas cosas que podr a decir y Armando entiende la amenaza. Michelle entre tanto discute con Diego Andr s porque l se niega a irse de luna de miel y descarga su rabia con Marisela que se acerca a llevarles champa a para su brindis, Diego Andr s lo rechaza y sale de la habitaci n y Michelle furiosa arroja la copa contra la puerta.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

R mulo queda desconcertado pues Eglee ni lo neg ni lo afirmo, o se que, quedo pero que cuando no le hab a preguntado nada. Mientras tanto Betzaida esta furiosa pues su marido no aparece por ninguna parte, le cuenta a su mam que R mulo se hab a parado enfrente de la casa de su ex y Nely para tratar de calmar la rabia de su hija trata de justificar a R mulo, cosa que a Betzaida le molesta mucho. Theo por su parte esta feliz, les da la noticia que le consigui un toque al grupo musical, todos se quedan locos pues ellos nunca pensaron que Theo se fuera a tomar las cosas tan en serio, al principio todos dijeron que no pero como Jos Tadeo entiende que el lo que quiere es levantarse a su millonaria entonces deciden ayudarlo y tocar n la semana pr xima. En la oficina se quedan trabajando hasta tarde, Santiago los quiere dejar solos a Luis Fernando y a Dileidi, busca un motivo para irse, pero Luis Fernando le ofrece la cola a Dileidi, pero cuando est n a punto de salir se aparece Aureliano y le ofrece a Dileidi llevarla hasta su casa, Luis Fernando se pone bravo, en ese momento tambi n se aparece la miss, y entonces Luis Fernando se saca la piedrita y coquetea con ella delante de Dileidi, quien aprovecha para decirle a la miss que ahora ella trabaja con su profe papi en la misma oficina, la miss se controla y no le queda mas remedio que felicitarla. Rosa habla con su hija le saca con mucha sutileza e inteligencia lo que paso la noche anterior con Santiago, a Eglee no le queda otra que contarle a su mam que si que paso una noche maravillosa con el muchacho, a lo que su madre le da el visto bueno, le aconseja que lo disfrute que ella conoce varias amigas suyas que tambi n tiene relaciones con hombres mucho mas j venes que ellas, pero Eglee le aclara que en su caso es mas dif cil pues se trata del mejor amigo de su hijo, tambi n le cuenta que ya R mulo sospecha algo pues le estuvo preguntando cualquier cantidad de cosas, Rosa disfruta del chisme como nunca. Gladis lleva a Yuraima a estudiar ya que parece que el Gerson no ir mas bueno no le queda de otra que entonces intentarlo con su nuera, quien asiste muy entusiasmada a su primer d a de clase. Aristigueta no puede creer que su amigo Marco Aurelio este enamorado, sobre todo el que no cree en las relaciones de pareja, pero Marco Aurelio se defiende diciendo que con la mujer que esta saliendo le pasa algo extra o, esa mujer le inspira muchas cosas a la vez, que el la ayuda no por que ella lo necesite pues ya le ha demostrado que para ella o hay obst culo cuando de su familia se trata, total es una mujer fuera de serie en la que Aristigueta nunca se fijar a. Tatiana se re ne con su pap , quiere escuchar ahora la versi n de el, pues solo sabe lo que le ha dicho la Nena de su pap , el por supuesto que le dice cualquier cantidad de mentiras, que ellas son lo mas importante en su vida, que esta arrepentido, que la nica mujer que vale la pena es su mam en fin la muchacha le cree todo el cuento inclusive que esta enfermo y hasta que le dio un infarto. Gonzalo le da la buena noticia a su mujer que le consigui un trabajo para el proyecto del centro comercial que est n construyendo, ella por supuesto que no lo puede creer, le pregunta a Ram n si es verdad que su marido la sugiri a ella y a Ram n no le quedo otra que decir que si que fue idea de Gonzalo. Theo llega a la casa de la Nena para contarle que ya consigui el primer contrato, ella cree que quien lo ayudo fue su amigo el doctor y Theo le dice que no, que fue el solo, pero se lleva una sorpresa al ver en la mesa hay toda clase de exquisiteces, la Nena le dice que sus alumnas decidieron darle un aguinaldo y que ella se lo gasto en esas cosas. Dileidi habla claro con Aureliano, le dice que no ella no esta siendo justa con el, que lo esta utilizando para darle celos a Luis Fernando, Aureliano sabe que es as tal cual como ella se lo dice, ella le confiesa que no puede hacer nada que esta enamorada de Luis Fernando. En la casa de Eglee todos comen hallaca, bueno no todos, Mar a Gracia no come en la tardes por aquello de la figura, otra que no come es Felicita quien se ve gorda o sea que tiene a la bulimia bien cerca de ella. R mulo al fin se digna a llegar a la casa de su nueva suegra, su mujer lo recibe con tremendo l o, los padres de ella de nuevo le dan la raz n a el y Betzaida les aclara que ya esta bueno de que siempre lo justifiquen a el y no a ella. Al d a siguiente en la bodega de Gabito Theo le cuenta a su amigo que le pareci extra o ver tanta comida cara en la casa de su millonaria adem s ella le dio un trato anormal, sinti que no fue sincera, Gabito le explica que eso es normal pues ella alguna vez tuvo mucho dinero y esta acostumbrada a comer bien, pero en eso llega el Gerson y les echa el cuento de que esta trabajando en el edificio donde vive la Nena, Theo le pregunta que si la vio y el le cuenta que hasta le tuvo que llevar el mercado al apartamento, mercado que le regalaba un tal jefe con una camioneta ltimo modelo, Theo se angustia descubre que no es solo el quien esta detr s de Mar a Antonia, tiene competencia y para colmo de males millonario de verdad.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Down Under: The Wild West of Cooking
programme.desc: Melbourne, Australia boasts hard-living, good-natured, and eccentric lovers of food - Tony's kind of people. In search of the outlaws of food, Tony explores a pasteurization-free cheese factory, and an old-world cured jamon workshop.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Singapore: New York in Twenty Years
programme.desc: Tony sets out to find the real Singapore, with its multicultural restaurants and food markets. He samples prescription food dishes, explores the Geyland Serai Market, and rides the clean and efficient local subway.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, NY: Passionate about his city, Tony gives us an intimate tour of the New York City foods he loves - sturgeon and bagels, fluke ceviche, pan-seared foie gras, braised veal cheek, authentic cheese and, of course, a hotdog.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Cobra Heart-Food That Makes You Manly
programme.desc: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: After taking a cyclo-ride through Ho Chi Minh City and trying various foods from roadside vendors and markets, Tony tests his might with a few shots of snake wine and a live cobra heart.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Eating on the Edge of Nowhere
programme.desc: Cambodia and Japan: Taking his obsession with the film Apocalypse Now a little too seriously, Tony sets out for Pailin, reputed to be one of the most dangerous towns on earth. After his journey, Tony returns to Japan.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: What is a Carioca? The natives of Rio de Janiero, Brazil are lovable scamps who find ways to avoid work, preferring the beach, flirting, and hanging out at restaurants and bars instead. Tony, under the tutelage of an exemplary Carioca, gives the lifestyle a try.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Jumping into a Thai tuk tuk taxi, Tony attempts to soak up Thai culture, and get lost in the cuisine of Chiang Mai, Thailand.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Cambodia: With a friend along for the ride, Tony travels to Phnom Penh, Cambodia, where he explores a food culture that is both pleasing to the palette and slightly frightening.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: No Beads, No Babes, No Bourbon Street
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone, gets in trouble with the law, eats jambalaya with a dancing chef, and relaxes to some local jazz.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Food Tastes Better with Sand Between Your Toes
programme.desc: In the Caribbean paradise of St. Martin, Tony eats a healthy Rastafarian meal with a freedom fighter, helps prepare grub for a food caravan, discovers foodstuffs not available at American supermarkets, and finally relaxes at a beach bar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony embarks on a pilgrimage to Sydney, Australia so he may indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs - Tetsuya Wakuda.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, NY and Provincetown, MA: Experience the formative moments of Tony's career as he revisits his first job, the culinary institute that taught him the basics, a normal workday at Les Halles Brasserie, and his mysterious mentor, Bigfoot.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Los Angeles, My Own Heart of Darkness
programme.desc: Los Angeles, CA: New York chef, Anthony Bourdain, descends into the culinary underbelly of his metropolitan nemesis, Los Angeles, where he experiences the trials of celebrity fame and the joys of West Coast cuisine.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Rural Japan: Tony decides to look for a more relaxing, traditional Japanese culinary experience in the countryside. Tony travels to an old-style Japanese inn that specializes in kaiseki cuisine, ancient tea ceremony, and local ingredients.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: In their Chicago backyard Rick, and his daughter Lanie, gather the last of the season's tomatoes to make a big batch of Salsa Mexicana, and that is just the starting point for a fast-paced salsa dance that goes way beyond tomatoes.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Over a breakfast of tortas, Rick and his daughter, Lanie, plan an all-day torta marathon in Mexico City. Their quest begins at the city's charming Sunday flea market, Lagunilla, where they check out some simple, yet mouthwatering tortas.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Nothing captures the spirit of a day at the beach in Mexico than a fresh seafood cocktail or ceviche, and Rick finds a classic version in Mexico City. Then, he visits a major-league marisqueria, and shares his tips for homemade ceviche.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Inside The Westin in Kuala Lumpur, Phillip visits Prego where Executive Chef Aizat Hakim Feisal creates his impressive signature dishes. Phil also experiences QBA, an energetic bar that will take you back half a century to Havana, Cuba.

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: Jeremy begins with the perfect party platter- delicious Steamed Bao with Black Pepper Beef Short-Rib filling. Next, he teaches Joe how to make Salt and Pepper Chili Squid. Jeremy then fires up the barbecue to make a Soy Chicken Burrito.

programme.title: Green Paradise

programme.title: Green Paradise

Located within this extraordinary mountain range exist two granite towers overlooking the Patagonian plain amid flourishing waters.

programme.title: Mythical Roads

programme.title: Mythical Roads

programme.title: Sennentuntschi
programme.desc: 1975, Swiss Alps: In a remote mountain village, a beautiful and mysterious woman shows up. Only the village policeman takes care of the strange woman and tries to find out who she is. There are hints that she came from the H??henalp Alp, where herdsmen do unthinkable things to get the company of women. Many dark truths are revealed that should better have remained hidden. A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.title: Psychos in Love
programme.desc: A strip-joint owner and a manicurist find that they have many things in common, the foremost being that they are psychotic serial killers. They fall in love and are happy being the family that slays together, until one day they come up against a plumber who also happens to be a cannibal.

programme.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
programme.desc: When a sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure. Now, she must smoke out the whole school before it's too late.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Jerónimo Best, actor y productor de teatro que ha llevado su carrera a escenarios nacionales e internacionales, incluyendo la Royal Shakespeare Company en Reino Unido. Jerónimo nos comparte sus inicios en el teatro, la emoción de pisar escenarios legendarios y cómo la actuación, en inglés y en español, transforma la manera de sentir y comunicar emociones. Además, Jerónimo reflexiona sobre su labor como productor, traductor y adaptador de proyectos teatrales, así como la importancia de crear equipos actorales que funcionen como una familia. Con humor, sensibilidad y mucha pasión por el oficio, Jerónimo nos invita a mirar el teatro como un espacio donde la ficción detiene el tiempo y nos recuerda el poder de las historias para emocionar, unir y transformar.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: Cocinisima

programme.title: Historias de Amor en Sunflower Valley

programme.title: La Bella Bestia
programme.desc: Inspirada en la clásica historia de la Bella y la Bestia. Isabelle es una hermosa mujer, pero solo en el exterior. Es la reina de su glamurosa sociedad, pasa los días echándose a perder a sí misma y gastando su dinero. Un día, en medio del campo y en pleno invierno, se pierde y se hace daño. Por suerte, tropieza con Jeremy, un hombre solitario, que es capaz de ponerla en su sitio. Ella se da cuenta de que en su interior tiene escondida una bestia aunque no lo quiera reconocer.

programme.title: The Journey Within

programme.title: The Journey Within

programme.title: HuntStand Presents

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: Stone Roses - Made Of Stone
programme.desc: In 2012, a resurrection no one thought possible took place when legendary band, The Stone Roses reformed after 16 years. With unprecedented access to previously unseen archive footage, MADE OF STONE is a revealing journey through the life of one of the most revered and influential bands in British music history.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: Johnny Thunders - Madrid Memory
programme.desc: A long lost live concert performance from The Heartbreakers explosive 1984 reunion world tour that included fellow Dolls Sylvain Sylvain & Jerry Nolan plus Billy Rath!
